description: Use this when the user asks to draw or design a floor plan as a real CAD drawing and wants it made now. The AI drafter of the Plan Chat CAD studio draws a layered, dimensioned plan (walls, doors, windows, furniture, dimensions, room names and areas) from the description and, if attached, a sketch or photo of a plan. Needs the user's AI Architectures account and spends credits from it (usually 700 to 1,800 credits per drawing; get_credit_balance shows the balance). Drawing takes 1 to 5 minutes; then call get_cad_drawing with the returned drawing_id. Confirm the brief with the user before starting.

brief.description: The building: type, rooms with sizes if known, storeys, overall size or plot, style. Any language. With a sketch, say what it shows.

sketch.description: A sketch, photo or screenshot of a floor plan the user attached in the chat.

sketch_url.description: Optional https URL of a sketch, photo or screenshot of a floor plan (JPG, PNG, WebP, HEIC; up to 15 MB), if no file was attached.

units.description: m = metres and m², ft = feet-inches and sq ft. Use ft for US users.

name: start_cad_drawing
